name: Sky Temple

mechanic.title: Temple Control & Laser Bombardment
mechanic.description: Ancient Temples (Top, Mid, and Bot) activate in phases (first warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00; 2:00 cooldown after a phase ends). Standing on an active Temple pad activates its beam to fire automatic energy shots at enemy structures—prioritizing the closest outer lane—while spawning Temple Guardians that attack occupants. Each Temple fires up to 45 shots total (including a final 5-shot burst) before deactivating.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the mid-left and bottom-right areas. Long-range boulder throwers; easy to take early and ideal for pushing bottom lane while teams fight over the Top/Mid temples.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left and top-right. High durability with a spell armor aura; captures top lane pressure right before Bottom Temple phases.

camps.name: Boss / Sand Golem (1 Camp)
camps.notes: Located in the bottom-mid alcove. Uses sand-tornado knockbacks and heavy slams; pushes bottom lane as a potent late-game win condition.

strategy: Sky Temple is a three-lane macro battleground with predictable early objective spawns: the first phase always activates Top and Mid Temples simultaneously, and the second phase always activates Bot Temple alone. Global heroes (Falstad, Dehaka, Brightwing) and strong zone-control mages or bruisers excel at holding Temple pads against Guardians and enemy pokes. Time your Bruiser and Siege camps on the opposite side of the map right before Temple activations to force the enemy into losing structures regardless of the objective outcome.
